newsitem.title: USA: CNG Energy Q2 megawatt-hour sales up.
newsitem.headline: CNG Energy Q2 megawatt-hour sales up.

text.p: CNG Energy Services Corp said today it sold 4.5 million megawatt-hours of electricity in the second quarter, nearly 10 times the 477,000 sold in the same period last year.
CNG, the unregulated energy marketing subsidiary of Consolidated Natural Gas Co, said in a statement its wholesale power sales for the first six months of the year totaled 7.1 million megawatt-hours.
"That total already exceeds the 5.0 million megawatt-hours sold in all of 1996," it said, adding that power sales for the same period last year were 1.3 million.

"And these numbers do not reflect some of our recently announced deals," it added, referring to a 10-year contract to supply Ormet Primary Aluminum Corp and a one-year contract with the Association of Bay Area Governments.
Consolidated Natural Gas Co is a producer, transporter, distributor and marketer of natural gas.
